name: spit-language
description: Live diagnostics for SPIT pipeline files

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SPIT runs the `spit` executable on the files of the workspace.

spit.executablePath.description: Path to the SPIT executable. Set in user settings only, so that a workspace cannot choose a program to run. Leave empty to use a sibling SPIT build or the executable on PATH.

spit.sourcesFile.description: Inventory file for this pipeline. Relative paths are resolved from the pipeline file. Leave empty to use a sibling file with the same name and a .sources extension, when present.

spit.rootDirectory.description: Root for discovering source files and directory contexts. Relative paths are resolved from the pipeline file. A pipeline with a discover declaration uses its own folder when this is empty. An explicit inventory takes precedence.
